hero.title: Medical appointments without queues, without waking up early, without uncertainty
hero.subtitle: SaludYa connects patients with the staff of public health facilities in Peru. Book your appointment, get notified when a slot is freed, and arrive right on time.
hero.imgAlt: Patient using the SaludYa app on their phone

problem.title: The problem we solve
problem.subtitle: In public health facilities, getting an appointment still depends on waking up early and standing in long queues.

card1.title: Waking up without certainty
card1.text: Patients arrive as early as 4:30 a.m. and still do not always find an available slot.

card2.title: Lost appointment slots
card2.text: Cancellations and no-shows are not reassigned because there is no formal record.

card3.title: Paper-based management
card3.text: Administrative staff work with notebooks and Excel sheets, which causes errors and overload.

solution.title: The SaludYa solution
solution.subtitle: Two mobile apps working together: one for the patient and one for the facility staff.

business.title: Business model
business.subtitle: SaludYa is a service with no direct cost to the patient. It is sustained through institutional implementation in public health facilities and agreements with health networks and DIRIS.

card1.title: Institutional implementation
card1.text: Public facilities license the platform to digitize their appointment management.

card2.title: Agreements with health networks
card2.text: Partnerships with MINSA, SIS and DIRIS for early adoption and official backing.

card3.title: Support and training
card3.text: Support and training services for clinical and administrative staff.

about.title: About RuwaLabs and SaludYa
about.subtitle: We are a startup formed by Software Engineering students at Universidad Peruana de Ciencias Aplicadas. Our goal is to digitize appointment management in public health facilities in Peru.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: To reduce barriers to healthcare access in the Peruvian public system, eliminating unnecessary queues and ensuring that every available slot is used by those who need it.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.text: To become the standard for digital appointment management in public health facilities in Peru, with a simple, accessible and reliable solution for both patients and staff.

values.title: Our values
values.v1: Accessibility: design for everyone, including those unfamiliar with technology.
values.v2: Transparency: clear information about availability, slots and care status.
values.v3: Collaboration: we work hand in hand with health staff and patients.
values.v4: Social impact: every operational improvement translates into better care for people.

about.closing: We are a team of Software Engineering students at UPC working to reduce barriers to public healthcare access in Peru.
